name: Noetix Bumi
summary: Bumi is a 94 cm, 12 kg consumer humanoid priced at 9,998 yuan, marketed as the first sub-10,000 yuan humanoid in China. It walks, runs and dances, and supports voice interaction and drag-and-drop programming for children. It is meant for education and family entertainment, not household chores.
highlights: Robozaps reports the first 500 units sold within 48 hours on JD.com.
48 V battery of 3.5 Ah or more.
caveats: Sold in China only as of early 2026, per Robozaps; deliveries were delayed.

sources.title: China's Noetix Robotics launches $1,400 consumer-grade humanoid robot
